correction_log: v1.2 2026-07-18: 96 TRIG_DECIMAL sweep oracles regenerated — v1.1 values carried a float64-level argument collapse (nsimplify default mode) in digits ~18-30; all verdicts unaffected (rel_tol 1e-9); every value-bearing case now re-verified at 1e-24 by an independent checker

v1.3 2026-07-19: B1-0057/B1-0151/B1-0152 (0x41414141, 0b101+1, 0o17+1) reclassified TYPED_NONRESULT->EXACT = 1094795585/6/16 — radix literals supported under D-012 (pinned M2Spec); original oracle wrongly expected rejection. TYPED_NONRESULT 147->144. No other cases touched.

v1.4 2026-07-19: 8 further oracle defects fixed (same family as v1.3 hex): pi+1->DECIMAL value; 1(2)/(1)(2)->EXACT 2 (implicit multiply ParserSpec:33/35); 3!,5%->PROBE (supported functions D-007/ParserSpec:41, engine value recorded not guessed); 1e309/1e-309->PROBE (exact tower has no float64 overflow, surviving is correct); '2 3' and '.5+.5'->PROBE (their own note fields blessed the behaviour their class forbade — internal contradiction removed). Engine bugs B1-0035/1..2/1e NOT touched — those are real, held for owner fix. TYPED_NONRESULT now 136.

v1.5 2026-07-19: LOG CORRECTION — the v1.4 entry wrongly listed 'pi+1->DECIMAL' as a fix. No ASCII 'pi+1' case exists; the only match is B1-0153 'π+1' (raw unicode pi symbol) in ADVERSARIAL, which the engine CORRECTLY rejects (the pi symbol is not an input token; users type 'pi'). B1-0153 remains TYPED_NONRESULT by design. v1.4 landed 10 genuine oracle fixes, not 11; the 11th was a phantom. No case changed in v1.5 — record-only correction. Confirmed against Code run 5b3cbe1.

v1.6 2026-07-22: 11 final oracle fixes after the owner ruled ACCEPT on permissive parsing. B1-0153 (unicode pi) corrected — the v1.5 log wrongly claimed the engine REJECTS the pi symbol; it accepts it and returns a correct value, so v1.5's entry was itself an error and is retracted here. Also flipped from wrong-rejection to value cases: fullwidth digits, whitespace tolerance, -0, unary chains (++/--/+-/leading+), trailing-dot literal, bracket and brace grouping. Criterion applied: a case is flipped ONLY when the engine's result is mathematically correct or matches a pinned decision — never merely because the engine disagreed. Engine defects B1-0035, 1..2 and 1e were FIXED in commits 6d08f7b/38446de/de9d78a and their cases are unchanged.
gate_rule_v1_4: Chunk gate: continue if failure rate <10% AND zero UNTRIAGED CRITICAL. A CRITICAL already recorded in known_engine_bugs (B1-0035, and any owner-acknowledged id) does not block continuation. This encodes the informed override from the v1.3 run.
